## Import



WeData workflow permissions can be imported using the projectId#entityId#entityType, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Wedata/workflowPermissions:WorkflowPermissions example 3108707295180644352#53e78f97-f145-11f0-ba36-b8cef6a5af5c#folder
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
